hariḥ om
{candrajñānam}
pañcākṣaraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ paramānandarūpiṇam | parāpararahasyaṃ syāt śṛṇu tvaṃ tu hite priye || 1 ||
sthūlasūkṣma vibhāvena sūkṣmāt sūkṣmaṃ dvibhāvanam | ānandaṃ praṇavaṃ bījaṃ ānandarūpanṛttakam || 2 ||
dhyānaṃ naṭeśvaraṃ proktaṃ pañcākṣaraparaṃ śivam | pañcākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma pavitraṃ pāvanāśanam || 3 ||
yakāramīśavaktraṃ tu vakāraṃ tatpuruṣavaktrakam | śikāraṃ ghorava (**********)|| 4 ||
(*******) vakāraṃ īśvara daivatam | yakāraṃ ca sadāśaivaṃ pañcadaivādhidaivatam || 5 ||
sthūla sūkṣmaparaṃ jyotiḥ pañcākṣaravidhiṃ śṛṇu | nakāraṃ ca makāraṃ ca śikāraṃ ca vakārakam || 6 ||
yakāraṃ pañcasaṃyuktaṃ praṇavādi ṣaḍakṣaram | akṣarāt praṇavaṃ mukhyaṃ akṣaraṃ jñānapūrvakam || 7 ||
praṇavaṃ akṣaraṃ proktaṃ sarvamantraṃ tadāspadam | praṇavena vihīnaṃ syāt tanmantraṃ prāṇahīnakam || 8 ||
sarvamantreṣu mantrāṇāṃ prāṇān praṇavamucyate |
prathamasvarasaṃyuktaṃ pañcamasvarasaṃyutam || 9 ||
ṣaḍvargāntasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam | evaṃ tatpraṇavaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ śubham || 10 ||
dhāntaṃ bhantaṃ ca śāntaṃ ca tṛtīyasvarasaṃyutam | lāntadīrghasvaropetaṃ māntaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ param || 11 ||
oṃkāraṃ ca nakāraṃ ca makāraṃ cākṣaratrayam | pulliṅgaṃ syād vakāraṃ śikāraṃ strīyutaṃ bhavet || 12 ||
yakāraṃ napuṃsakaṃ jñeyaṃ trayastvevaṃ tataḥ kramāt | ṛgvedaṃ syānnakāraṃ ca yajurvedaṃ makārakam || 13 ||
śikāraṃ sāmavedaṃ syāt makāramatharvarṇaṃ bhavet |
itihāsaṃ yakāraṃ ca sarvadevamayaṃ tathā || 14 ||
varṇaṃ devaṃstathā śaktistvādhārachanda eva ca | ṛṣisthānaṃ ca brahmaṃ ca āyudhaṃ tu tathaiva ca || 15 ||
kalāguṇaṃ ca cakraṃ ca prakāśaṃ karaṇameva ca | vāyurjñānendriyaṃ caiva ityete ṣoḍaśa kramāt || 16 ||
nakāraṃ pṛthivīrūpaṃ brahmaṃ tatrādhidaivatam | sāvitrīṃ śaktirityuktaṃ ādhāraṃ pṛthivī tathā || 17 ||
anuṣṭupchandasaṃyuktaṃ vasiṣṭhastu ṛṣistathā | sthānaṃ paścimato vaktraṃ sadyojātaṃ tu brahmakam || 18 ||
āyudhaṃ vajramevoktaṃ kalā nivṛttireva ca |
guṇāṅkane menāṃ tu ghanena catuśravoktaṃ cakrameva ca || 19 ||
jvālitāgniprakāśena karaṇamahaṃkārameva ca | prāṇavāyusamāyuktamindriyaṃ caiva gandhakam || 20 ||
ityete ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu nakārākṣaramucyate | nakārākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ makārākṣaramatha śṛṇu || 21 ||
makāraṃ jalarūpaṃ tu daivaṃ viṣṇustathaiva ca | lakṣmīśaktisamāyuktamādhāraṃ jalameva ca || 22 ||
triṣṭupchandassamāyuktaṃ viśvāmitro(?) ṛṣistathā | sthānamuttarato vaktraṃ vāmadevaṃ tu brahmakam || 23 ||
padmāyudhaṃ caiva(?) pratiṣṭhā tu kalā hi ca |
guṇadravyaṃ syādapi ca cakramardhendujaṃ tathā || 24 ||
somasūryaprakāśena karaṇaṃ buddhireva ca | apāne vāyurūpaṃ tu rasaṃ jñānendriyaṃ bhavet || 25 ||
ityete ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu makārākṣaramucyate | makāra (****)śikārākṣaramatha śṛṇu || 26 ||
śikāramagnirūpaṃ tu rudrastatrādhidaivatam | gaurīśaktisamāyuktaṃ ādhāramagnireva ca || 27 ||
triṣṭupchandassaṃyukto jamadagnistathā (***) | sthānaṃ dakṣiṇato vaktraṃ aghoraṃ brahmameva ca || 24 ||
svastikāyudhamevoktaṃ vidyāgni tu kalā hi ca |
guṇadīptisamāyuktaṃ cakraṃ tu tryagrameva ca || 29 ||
taṭittulyaṃ prakāśena karaṇaṃ tu manastathā | vya (*****) yaktaṃ jñānendriyaṃ tu rūpakam || 30 ||
ityete ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu śikārākṣaramucyate | śikārākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ vakārākṣaramatha śṛṇu || 31 ||
vakāraṃ vāyurūpaṃ syāt adhidaivatamīśvaram | ambikā tu mahāśaktirvāyurādhārameva ca || 32 ||
bṛhatī chandassaṃyuktaṃ ṛṣiḥ kāśyāpa ucyate | sthānaṃ tu pūrvato vaktraṃ brahmaṃ tat (*****) || 33 ||
ādhāraṃ bindurūpaṃ tu kalā śāntistathaiva ca |
guṇasparśa na saṃyuktaṃ ṣaḍagraṃ cakrameva ca || 34 ||
dīpaprakāśamevoktaṃ karaṇaṃ cittameva ca | (***) vāyusaṃyuktaṃ sparśaṃ jñānendriyaṃ bhavet || 35 ||
ityete ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu vakāra (**)mucyate | vakārākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ yakārākṣaramatha śṛṇu || 36 ||
yakāra (**)rūpaṃ tu daivaṃ caiva sadāśivam | unmanīśaktisaṃyuktamādhāraṃ vyomamucyate || 37 ||
jagatī chanda saṃyuktaṃ bharadvāja ṛṣistathā | sthānamūrdhvamukhaṃ vidyāt brahmamīśānameva ca || 38 ||
āyudhānāṃ triśūlaṃ syāt śāntyātī ca kalā hi ca |
guṇaṃ caiva tu śūnyaṃ syāt prakāśaṃ candrikāmaṇeḥ || 39 ||
karaṇaṃ prakṛtirūpaṃ syāt samānavāyustathaiva ca | śabda jñānendriyaṃ caiva ityete ṣoḍaśa kramāt || 40 ||
yakārākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ na bhūto na bhaviṣyati | pañcākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ praṇavākṣaramatha śṛṇu || 41 ||
praṇavaṃ ātmarūpaṃ tu paramātmādhidaivatam | svāhādevī mahāśaktirādhāraṃ paramaṃ padam || 42 ||
gāyatrī chandasaṃyuktaṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ paramaṃ padam | sthānaṃ śivamukhaṃ proktaṃ brahmaṃ śivamukhaṃ bhavet || 43 ||
āyudhaṃ śūnyamevoktaṃ śūnyakā tu kalā'pi ca |
nirguṇīṃ nirāmayaṃ cakraṃ prakāśaṃ śatasahasrakam || 44 ||
niṣkaramiti nirvāyurindriyāṇāṃ tu ṣoḍaśa | ityete ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu praṇavaṃ praṇave namaḥ || 45 ||
akāraṃ ca ukāraṃ ca makāro bindureva ca | ardhacandranirodhī ca nādau nādāntameva ca || 46 ||
śaktiśca vyāpinī caiva samānā conmanā tathā | samānāntaṃ pāśajālaṃ syānmanyante paraśśivaḥ || 47 ||
saptakoṭimahāmantraṃ cittavyākulakāraṇam | ekabījaṃ mahāmantraṃ turyātītaṃ manolayam || 48 ||
dviraṣṭakakalopetaṃ praṇavaṃ yo na vindati |
nāso mantrī na cācāryo vṛthā kliśyati karmasu || 49 ||
bujasyoccāraṇaṃ cāgraṃ svapno binduparigraheḥ | suṣuptirnādasaṃyogasturyaṃ śaktisamāgataḥ || 50 ||
turyātītaṃ layaṃ śāntaṃ paro mahasi paṭhyate | prāṇāyāmaṃ trayaṃ kṛtvā śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 51 ||
nakāraṃ sṛṣṭirūpaṃ syānmakāraṃ sthitirūpakam | śikāraṃ saṃhṛtiścaiva vakāraṃ tu tirobhavam || 52 ||
yakāramanugrahaṃ caiva pañcākṣaramidaṃ jagat | nakāraṃ kṛtayutaṃ syānmakāraṃ tretāyugaṃ bhavet || 53 ||
śikāraṃ dvāparaṃ caivakāraṃ kaliyugaṃ tathā |
yakāra yugāntaraṃ caiva pañcākṣaramidaṃ jagat || 54 ||
śaivaṃ pāśupataṃ caiva bauddhamārhataṃ tathā | kāpālaṃ pāñcarātraṃ ca ṣaḍete samayā smṛtāḥ || 55 ||
brahmacārī nyaset sṛṣṭi grahasthasya sthitirbhavet | vānaprasthayatīnāṃ tu saṃhāranyāsamucyate || 56 ||
aṅguṣṭhena yakāraṃ syāt vakāraṃ tarjanīṃ nyaset | śikāraṃ madhyamāṅgulyā makāraṃ tu anāmikam || 57 ||
kaniṣṭhena nakāraṃ syāt sṛṣṭinyāsamudāhṛtam | yakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya vakāraṃ tu lalāṭake || 58 ||
śikāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya makāraṃ nābhideśataḥ | nakāraṃ pādayo nyasya sarvāṅge praṇavaṃ nyaset || 59 ||
nakāraṃ ātmaśuddhyarthaṃ makāraṃ sthānaśodhanam | śikāraṃ liṅgaśuddhistu pañcaśuddhirvidhikramam || 60 ||
(****************) | (****************) || 61 ||
anantaṃ pṛthivī jñeyaṃ āpassiṃhāsanaṃ tathā | āgniyogamidaṃ proktaṃ vāyurūpaṃ tathaiva ca || 62 ||
ākāśaṃ vimalaṃ caiva pañcāsanavidhikramam | āvāhanaṃ nakāreṇa sthāpanaṃ tu makārakam || 63 ||
śikāreṇa tu sānnidhyaṃ vakāreṇārghyameva ca | pūjayettu yakāreṇa śivaṃ paramakāraṇam || 64 ||
pīṭhaṃ praṇavarūpaṃ tu kalpayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ | nakārasya kalāḥ pañca makārasya catuṣkalāḥ || 65 ||
śikārasya kalā cāṣṭau vakārasya trayodaśa | yakārasya kalā cāṣṭau pañcākṣarakalā nyaset || 66 ||
śikāraṃ śivarūpaṃ tu vakāraṃ śaktireva ca | yakāramātmarūpaṃ tu nakāraṃ tu tirobhavet || 67 ||
makāraṃ malarūpaṃ tu iti pañcākṣaraṃ smṛtam | āvāhanaṃ nakāraṃ ca makāraṃ padmamudrikā || 68 ||
śikāraṃ muṣṭimudrā ca vakāraṃ yogamudrikā | yakāraṃ liṅgamudrā ca śivamudrāṃ niyojayet || 69 ||
yakāraṃ liṅgasaṃyuktaṃ vakāraṃ nālameva ca | śikāramūrdhvapadmaṃ tu makāraṃ kaṇṭhameva ca || 70 ||
adhopadmaṃ nakāraṃ ca akṣaraṃ liṅgamucyate | pūjayā vipulaṃ rājyaṃ agnikāryeṇa saṃpadaḥ || 71 ||
japena pāpasaṃśuddhirdhyānamānandamuktidam | nakāraṃ pāpaharaṇaṃ makāraṃ pāpamocanam || 72 ||
mahādevo samo devo nāsti kaśca jagattraye | pañcākṣarasamo mantro nāsti nāsti mahāmune || 73 ||
pañcākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ bhasmeti paramauṣadham | mahādevaḥ paro bandhuriti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 74 ||
āgame (-)
madhye śivastataśśaktiḥ tato hyātmeti vismṛtaḥ | tatpūrvo bandhakaḥ proktastatpūrve tannivārakaḥ || 75 ||
anyatra (-)
śikāraṃ śivarūpaṃ syāt vakāraṃ śaktirucyate | yakāramātmasaṃyuktaṃ nakāraṃ tu tirobhavam || 76 ||
makāraṃ malarūpaṃ syāt pañcākṣaramiti smṛtam |
devikālottare (-)
rodhanaṃ jalamityuktaṃ ātmaśakti śivātmakam || 77 ||
pañcākṣaramidaṃ devī rahasyaṃ na prakāśayet |
ugripañcākṣaram |
bhagavandevadeveśa sarvajña karuṇālaya || 78 ||
pañcākṣararahasyaṃ hi śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ | pañcākṣaraṃ paraṃ mantraṃ rahasyaṃ muktidāyakam || 79 ||
kāmārtthāya sasaṃbhāya gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ | nāputrāya ca dātavyaṃ nāśiṣyāya kadācana || 80 ||
saptakoṭimahāmantraṃ cittavyākulakāraṇam | pañcākṣaramidaṃ devī triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 81 ||
puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ pañcākṣaramidaṃ japet | yasya smaraṇamātreṇa brahmahatyā vyapohita || 82 ||
evaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ devī śṛuṇutaṃ ta mahāmanum | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcākṣaravidhikramam || 83 ||
oṃ |
namaśśivāya saṃkalpya vyākhyānaṃ nāma pañcakam | nakāraṃ ca makāraṃ ca śikāraṃ ca tathaiva ca || 84 ||
vakāraṃ ca yakāraṃ ca idaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ viduḥ | etat pañcākṣaraṃ devī pañca devāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 85 ||
pañcākṣaraṃ pavitraṃ ca pañcabrahmamayaṃ tathā | pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca || 86 ||
pañcabrahmamahādevaḥ pañcatattve vyavasthitaḥ | brahmā(?) viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ || 87 ||
nakāraṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ makāraṃ viṣṇurūpakam | śikāraṃ rudrarūpaṃ tu vakāramīśvaraṃ tathā || 88 ||
yakāraṃ sadāśiva jñeyamityete adhidaivatāḥ | nakāraṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ tu makāraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇakam || 89 ||
śikāramagnivarṇaṃ tu vakāraṃ śyāmavarṇakam | yakāraṃ sphaṭikākāraṃ varṇabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 90 ||
nakāraṃ sadyavaktraṃ tu makāraṃ vāmadevakam | śikāraṃ ghorasaṃyuktaṃ vakāraṃ puruṣaṃ smṛtam || 91 ||
yakāraṃ gaganaṃ proktaṃ vaktrabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | ṛgvedaṃ tu nakāraṃ syāt yajurvedaṃ makārakam || 92 ||
śikāraṃ sāmavedaṃ tu vakāraṃ cāpyatharvaṇam | itihāsaṃ yakāraṃ ca sarvavedādivaibhavam || 93 ||
tasmāt pañcākṣaraṃ mantraṃ vācakasya sadā bhavet | oṃkāraparamaṃ devamoṃkāraṃ paramaṃ tathā || 94 ||
oṃkārādiyakārāntaṃ mantrametat ṣaḍakṣaram | nakāraṃ śāntikaṃ jñeyaṃ makāraṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathā || 95 ||
śikāramabhicāraṃ ca vakāraṃ vaśyameva ca | yakāraṃ muktidaṃ caiva ekamūrtikrameṇa tu || 96 ||
yāvat siddhiryadāsiddhirnityameva japaṃ tathā | pade pade japaṃ devī yo dadyāt sa vicakṣaṇaḥ || 97 ||
pañcākṣaraṃ paraṃ caitat sarvasiddhikaraṃ bhavet | evaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ jñeyaṃ mantraṃ trailokyadurlabham || 98 ||
[iti vidyāpurāṇe pañcākṣarapaṭalaṃ samāptam]
ukāraṃ ca umādevī akāraṃ śiva īritam | ubhayossaṃpuṭaṃ caiva pīṭhaṃ liṅgamiti smṛtam || 1 ||
cidambararahasye (-)
nakārapādau ca makārakukṣiśśikārasasyo mukhavāyumūrdhvā | krameṇa pañcākṣara divyarūpaṃ smaranti daṃ gacchati jīvamuktim || 2 ||
śikāraṃ makuṭaṃ proktaṃ vakāraṃ bāhurucyate | yakāramabhayaṃ hastaṃ nakāraṃ cāgnirūpakam || 3 ||
makāraṃ pādapadmaṃ yo apasmāraṃ bhavet sadā | sthitvā tadūrdhva ānandatāṇḍavaṃ kurute śivaḥ || 4 ||
tāṇḍaveśasya satataṃ śrīvāsi praṇavaṃ bhavet | ānandatāṇḍave kṛtyamātmanaḥ kurute śivaḥ || 5 ||
sṛṣṭi syādḍamaruke sthitiṃ tat syādabhayahastake | saṃhāraṃ cāgnirūpe syāttirobhāvaṃ sthirāṅghrike || 6 ||
anugrahaṃ cāparāṅghrau ātmanaḥ kurute śivaḥ | vidhūya māyāṃ pāpaṃ ca dagdhvaṃ pā jñānanāśanam || 7 ||
kṛtvoddhṛtya śivajñānahastenānanda sāgare | sthāpitaṃ paramātmānaṃ santataṃ śivatāṇḍavam || 8 ||
pañcākṣaraṃ parāmadhye pañcākṣaramayaṃ naṭam | saptakoṭimahāraṇyaṃ saptakoṭicarācaram || 9 ||
saptakoṭimahāliṅgaṃ tat śivaṃ tāṇḍavālayam | tāṇḍavālayamadhye tu niṣkalaṃ paradurlabham || 10 ||
idaṃ rahasyamaparaṃ aprakāśyamivācakam | prakaṭayasvedaṃ majjñānaṃ madbhaktānāṃ parānane || 11 ||
rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena taskarebhyo dhanaṃ yathā | pādāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhāntaṃ pañcākṣareṇa pūritam || 12 ||
pāṣṇoyaṃ tu nakāreṇa gulphajaṃ vai makārakam | jānu ūru śikāraṃ ca vakāraṃ guhyadeśakam || 13 ||
ādhāraṃ praṇavaṃ caiva tasya madhye nakārakam | yakāraṃ tu kaṭiḥ prokto rakāraṃ pṛṣṭhabhāgakam || 14 ||
śikāraṃ nābhirityuktaṃ makāraṃ kukṣideśikam | vakāraṃ hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ yakāraṃ stanadeśakam || 15 ||
nakāraṃ ca urasthānaṃ śikāraṃ bāhudeśakam | makāraṃ koparaṃ proktaṃ vakāraṃ maṇibandhanam || 16 ||
yakāraṃ ca talārūḍhaṃ aṅguṣṭhādi purā kramāt | ḍamarustu makāraṃ ca valayaṃ praṇavo bhavet || 17 ||
tanturnakāramityuktaṃ śikāraṃ carma īritam | vakāraṃ taṭirityāhurnādaṃ ca nāma mantrakam || 18 ||
tathā cābhayahastaṃ tu śṛṇuṣvaiva maheśvarī | tasya haste bhujaṅgastu sūkṣmapañcākṣaraṃ bhavet || 19 ||
vāmahastāgnirūpeṇa mama jyotirmaheśvara | tathācāparahastena sṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇam || 20 ||
nakāraṃ grīvamityuktaṃ makāraṃ kaṇṭhadeśakam | śikāraṃ hanudeśaṃ tu vakāraṃ cāsyadeśakam || 21 ||
yakāraṃ nāsideśaṃ tu netratrayaṃ tataśśṛṇu | nakāraṃ sarvanetraṃ tu makāraṃ vāmanetrakam || 22 ||
ūrdhvanetraṃ śikāraṃ tu vakāraṃ śravaṇena tu | bhrūmadhye praṇavaṃ caiva madhye haṃsaṃ sudīptakam || 23 ||
yakāraṃ śirasi nyasya aṅgapratyaṅgake tathā | dvādaśākṣaramantraṃ tu jaṭācūḍamitīritam || 24 ||
māyābījaṃ jalaṃ caiva dhūrddharādistathaiva ca | sarvākṣaramiśrakaṃ syāt indukhaṇḍamiti smṛtam || 25 ||
pañcākṣareṇa dehastu dehī vai nāmamantrataḥ | ānandanṛttamamalaṃ nṛtyantaṃ niṣkalaṃ śivam || 26 ||
pañcākṣaramidaṃ yantraṃ bijānīyād gurormukhāt | nāputrāya pradātavyaṃ nāśiṣyāya tathaiva ca || 27 ||
putrāya putratulyāya dhārmikāya dṛḍhāya ca | sabhāyantramidaṃ proktaṃ dakṣiṇārādhanaṃ śṛṇu || 28 ||
|| nṛttapañcākṣaram samāptam ||
śrīḥ
candraḥ (-)
devadeva maheśāna suranāgendra bhūṣaṇam | snapanaṃ tu samākhyātamutsavaṃ vada śaṃkara || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca (-)

sthāpanaṃ tu mahālakṣmyāḥ kartavyaṃ deśikottamaiḥ | nirmāya śilpivaryeṇa lakṣmīṃ padmāsanasthitām || 2 ||

vāstuhomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mahālakṣmyāśca sannidhau | digbhyāṃ ityanuvākena aṅgahomamathācaret || 6 ||
pūrvoktavidhinā caiva akṣimocanamācaret | adhivāsatrayaṃ kṛtvā kṣīragavyaṃ jaleṣu ca || 7 ||
grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā yāgaśālāṃ praviśya ca | puṇyāha prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā pañcagavyaistathaiva ca || 8 ||

prāsārya parito dhānyairlikhitvā padmarekhayā | navakumbhaṃ susaṃsthāpya tantunā veṣṭitaṃ param || 10 ||
navāṃ ca lakṣmī pratimāṃ kumbheṣu parinikṣipet | navaratnādi nikṣipya nālikerāmrapallavam || 11 ||

nādād bindussamudbhūtaḥ bindotpannassadāśivam | sadāśivotpanna īśaṃ tu śuddhavidyā tatotbhavet || 9 ||
pūrvabindusamudbhūtā sūkṣmā vaikharyāntakam | vaikharīvarṇamutpannaṃ varṇo mantrāstatotbhavāḥ || 10 ||
saptakoṭimahāmantraiśśāstrajālaṃ tatoditam |
tattvaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ ca śabdeṣu śuddhatattvaṃ ca vardhate || 11 ||
anantadevakṛpayā atho māyāsamudbhavāḥ | kālaṃ niyatiścotpannaṃ kalā vidyā ca rāgakaḥ || 12 ||
rudradeva kalotpannā prakṛtistriguṇodbhavā | prakṛtyā caiva avyakte cittabuddhisamudbhavaḥ || 13 ||
buddherutpanne'haṃkāramahaṃkārastridhā bhavet | taijaso vaikharībhūtaṃ trividhaṃ nāmamucyate || 14 ||
taijasassāttvikaguṇo mano jñānendriyodbhavaḥ | ahaṃkāre vaikharīyuḥ karmendriyasamudbhavaḥ || 15 ||
tāmase bhūtāhaṃkāre tanmātraṃ ca samudbhavaḥ |
śabde ākāśamutpannaṃ sparśe vāyustathoditaḥ || 16 ||
rūpe guṇāgnissaṃbhūtaṃ rājase jalamudbhavam | gandhe mahī samudbhūta tattvakārye na ceṣṭitam || 17 ||
punastattveṣu bandhena gandhe pṛthvīṃ viyojayet | salilaṃ rasabandheṣu rūpeṇāgniṃ suyojayet || 18 ||
sparśe tu vāyumiśraṃ ca ākāśaṃ śabdasaṃpade | śabdādi pañcatanmātraṃ rūpe'haṃkāra bandhayet || 19 ||
karmendriyaṃ ca pañcaite rājase vaikharīyute | jñānendriyaṃ ca pañcaite'haṃkārastaijase gate || 20 ||
bhūtādi vaikharī caiva taijasaṃ buddhi cittayuk |
cittakṣetrajña yukteṣu pañcaviṃśatirāgake || 21 ||
rāgavidyā kalā niyati kāla tattveṣu bandhayet | śāstrajālaṃ ca mantrāṇi mantre varṇeṣu yojayet || 22 ||
varṇāṇi vaikharīyukte vaikharīmadhyamāyute | madhyamā caiva paśyanti paśyantī sūkṣma yojayet || 23 ||
sūkṣmāścatasro vāgrūpā pūrvabindu suyojayet | śuddhavidyā śivāntāni kuṭile yojayettataḥ || 24 ||
parāśakti pare yukto śṛvaṃ tattvāni yojayet | sṛṣṭisaṃhāramevoktaṃ sthitikramamathocyate || 25 ||
paraśśivaḥ parotbhūtaḥ icchājñānakriyātmikā |
pūrvakarma (*****) ṣṭhāgni cakravadbhramāt || 26 ||
vyomādipañcabhūtāni śrotrādīni hyadhiṣṭhitam | śabdādi pañcatanmātraṃ vartate dhāmasannidhau || 27 ||
vāgādikarmapañcāni vacanādīni vartate | mano buddhirahaṃkāraṃ cittaṃ caiva caturthakam || 28 ||
niścaya (**)gavyaṃ ca cintanaṃ tat kriyā biduḥ | ātmatattvamiti khyātaṃ darśanaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu || 29 ||
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaśca vartate kālatattvakam | niyatirniścayaṃ kuryāt kalānnītvā kriyotbhavā | vidyā jñānādikaṃ caiva rā (*******) || 30 ||
viṣayādi pañca ceṣṭante sākṣitvaṃ puruṣaṃ bhavet | māyā cittaṃ bhramaṃ kuryāt (*) ga kāṇḍamiti smṛtam || 31 ||
jñānādhikyaṃ kriyānyūnaṃ śuddhavidyā ca tattvakam | jñānasūkṣmaṃ kriyādhikyamīśatattvamiti smṛtam || 32 ||
(******)ka samaṃ sādākhyaṃ ca tato viduḥ | śaktitattvaṃ kriyotpannaṃ śivatattvaṃ tato'dhikam || 33 ||
prerakāṇḍaṃ ca pañcaite śivatattvamiti smṛtam | sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ caiva ṣaṭtriṃśat tattvadarśanam || 34 ||
māyā (*****) ñca satyantaṃ sūkṣmarūpakam | śivatattvaṃ paraṃ caiva guruvaktre pradarśayet || 35 ||
ṣaṇṇavatyādhike tattve cakravat bhramate sadā | viśrāmyaṃ ca tadātmā ca pañcāvasthākriyodbhavāḥ || 36 ||
jāgratsvapna suṣuptiśca kuryāvyometi pañcadhā | lalāṭe kaṇṭhahṛdaye nābhiliṅgāvasānakam || 37 ||
adho bhāgaṃ ca vartante pañcāvasthā tataśśṛṇu | śrotrādipañcakaṃ caiva śabdādi pañcakaṃ bhavet || 38 ||
vāgādi pañcatattvāni vacanādīni pañcadhā | prāṇādi daśavāyuśca manādi puruṣapañcayuk || 39 ||
pañcatriṃśati vartante jāgrat sthāne lalāṭake | prāṇādi vāyubhiścaiva śabdamādikaṃ daśa || 40 ||
karaṇaṃ ca caturthaṃ ca pañcaviṃśatikaṇṭake | jāgre viṣayabhogaṃ ca vāsanā snapanameva ca || 41 ||
ayasāgni samāyoge vidagniriva vāyu ca | cittaprāṇau ca kṣetranyo hṛdaye ca suṣupti hi || 42 ||
spapnaṃ ca vismṛtijāgre suṣuptiṃ caiva darśayet | ātmaprāṇaśca kurye tu vartate nābhimūlake || 43 ||
svapnaṃ nāsti śrutaṃ nāsti sturyābhāvassa mucyate | liṅgamūle tu kṣetrajño turyātītannamaśyate || 44 ||
sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ susūkṣmaṃ syāt atisūkṣmaṃ tato'dhikam | caturaṅgabalo mantrī rājācāntaḥparaṃ gataḥ || 45 ||
ityevaṃ pañcadhā'vasthā jīvātmā ca vahannṛpaḥ | atho'vasthā ca ityevaṃ madhyāvasthā tataḥ śṛṇu || 46 ||
jāgrasthāne lalāṭe tu atītāntāni darśayet | athovasthā ca madhyā ca jñātvā caivaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 47 ||
śuddhatattvāni pañcaite catustrīṇi dvyekaśaḥ | parāsaṃsthā iti jñeyā jāgrādīnāṃ ca bhāvayet || 48 ||
evaṃ pañcadaśāvasthā tridhāvasthā ca saṃyutam | kevalassakalo śuddho darśanaṃ ca tataśśṛṇu || 49 ||
jāgrāvasthādi turyāntaṃ sakalā ca iti smṛtam | atītaṃ kevalāvasthā śuddhā ca smarasīyutā || 50 ||
adhobhāgaṃ ca madhyaṃ ca ūrdhvabhāgaṃ tridhā bhavet | māyāvasthā ca evoktaṃ jāgraddṛśyaṃ tataśśṛṇu || 51 ||
śivādiśca kalādiśca manādī ca catuṣṭayaḥ | śrotrādi ekatattvaṃ ca śabdādi ekasaṃyutam || 52 ||
tattvamaṣṭādaśāyukto jāgratkāleṣu dṛśyate | śivasannidhimātre tu ātmānaṃ vartate sadā || 53 ||
jāgrat sthāneṣu dṛśyante yogānnyāsena buddhimān | jāge dṛśyapravṛttiśca pratyāhāreṇa śāmyati || 54 ||
dhāraṇena jayet svapnaṃ dhyānenaiva suṣupti hi | samādhinā tu turyaṃ tu turyātītaṃ śivena tu || 55 ||
sadgurorupadeśena svaprakāśena niścalam | ityevaṃ nirmalāvasthā arthapañcakamucyate || 56 ||
malaṃ karmā ca māyā ca mahāmāyā tirodhakam | arthapañcakamevoktaṃ pratyakṣaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu || 57 ||
icchājñāna kriyārūpi ātmabodhanna dṛśyate | tāmrakālīkavat kṛtvā āṇavaṃ śaktirucyate || 58 ||
prārabdhaṃ saṃcitaṃ caiva āgāmi ca trirūpakam | māyā ca vasturūpāṇi cittabhrama iti smṛtāḥ || 59 ||
niṣkalaṃ śivabhedaṃ ca nādabindvādikāraṇam | tanujjāraṇavijñāne mahāmāyā iti smṛtāḥ || 60 ||
ātmā ca śivayormadhye darpaṇaṃ ca ya pārśvayuk | dravyadṛśyātmapakvaṃ ca tirobhāva iti smṛtaḥ || 61 ||
evaṃ pañcamalaṃ nītvā śaktipādaṃ tataśśṛṇu | puṇyapāpa samāyukto śivaśaktinipātataḥ || 62 ||
teṣāṃ liṅgaṃ ca vijñānaṃ muktau puṃsatvameva ca | dveṣyaṃ tyavasthitibhāvo śivabhakteṣu bhaktibhiḥ || 63 ||
taccāsaneṣu śraddhā ca jñānācāryeṇa vāñchitaḥ | ravisannidhimātreṇa sūryakānto'gnirudbhavaḥ || 64 ||
gurusannidhimātreṇa śiṣyajñānaṃ prakāśyate | mandaṃ mandataraṃ caiva tīvraṃ tīvrataraṃ bhavet || 65 ||
kadalī cārdrakāṣṭaṃ ca indhanaṃ mūlameva ca | pakvāpakvaṃ caturbhedaṃ jñātvā bhedena buddhimān || 66 ||
jñānaṃ yogaḥ kriyā caryā sopānaṃ mokṣadaṃ padam | caryāpādaḥ kriyāpādaḥ dāso (**)vamucyate || 67 ||
śivo'haṃ bhāvayogaṃ ca sāyujyaṃ jñānapādakam | evaṃ śaivāgame mukhyaṃ pāśāt paśupatikramāt || 68 ||
tatra mantropadeśaṃ ca trividhaṃ bhedamucyate | bāhyabhāvaṃ manobhāvaṃ antarbhāvamiti smṛtam || 69 ||
triśū (****)laṃ ca manobhāvaṃ ca mantrakam | antarbhāvopadeśaṃ ca pāśaḥ paśupatirbhavet || 70 ||
niṣkalaṃ ca nirādhāramādhāraṃ cātra yogakam | layāvikārabhogaṃ ca maṇimantrauṣadhaṃ bhavet || 71 ||
ityeva (********)rthena darśayet | tatsāraṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvekāgramānasaḥ || 72 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśat tattvabhedaṃ ca pāśajñānamiti smṛtam | tattvātītaṃ ca yat proktaṃ ātmajñānamitirbhavet || 73 ||
ekameva dvayorjñānaṃ (********)| ityevaṃ trividhaṃ jñātvā sāyujyaṃ bhavati dhruvam || 74 ||
jñānapāśaḥ paśorbhāvaḥ patijñāna samāśrayam | saptadhātumayaṃ deho hyanityaśca yathā viduḥ || 75 ||
vyomādipañca bhūtānāṃ naśyate bhāvayet budhaḥ | (*****) tānītyā śabdādīnāṃ tu ceṣṭitam || 76 ||
karaṇaṃ tvāparaṃ tītvā kālādijñāna naśyati | guṇatrayaṃ tato bhinnaṃ śuddhavidyā sadāśivam || 77 ||
naśyante prāṇavāyuśca binduśaktigato bhavet | dehajñānendriya (*****) guṇavāyu tam || 78 ||
evaṃ pañcābhimānaṃ ca pañcāvasthā ca darśayet | tattvādiśaktiparyantaṃ tattvāni saha bhāvayet || 79 ||
tattvajñānaṃ jīvabhāvaṃ nityā tu śivatattvakam | evaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatattvāni naśyante darśanaṃ ca yat || 80 ||
tat jñānaṃ tmadarśanaṃ ca patijñānaṃ taducyate | tattvātītaṃ yat jñānaṃ tatjñānaṃ parajāgrajam || 81 ||
viśvabhakṣaṇa mevoktaṃ tatbhāvaṃ parasvapnakam | tatjñānaṃ vedaśāntiṃ ca suṣuptiḥ parameva ca || 82 ||
daśatriyaṃ tato nītvā svaprakāśaṃ guro padam | patijñānamiti proktaṃ sāyujyaṃ ca tataśśṛṇu || 83 ||
tatpadaṃ śivarūpaṃ ca tvatpadaṃ ātmabhāvakam | asiśabdaṃ ca sāyujyaṃ tattvajñānamiti smṛtam || 84 ||
vedāntaṃ yat paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ siddhāntaṃ ca tato viduḥ | samaṃrasī bhāvamevoktaṃ mātṛbhāvamathocyate || 85 ||
prā (*) bhāvamutsṛjya śivo'hamiti bhāvayet | sarvacintāvinirmuktaḥ ekenaiva vivarjitam || 86 ||
pādāṅguṣṭhā (*) mūrdhā taṃ sthānaṃ dhyānavivarjitam | ākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ vācyavācakavarjitam || 87 ||
jñātvā śivamayaṃ madhye jyoti (*) kṣi prakāśite | śrotraṃ nāsti śrutistatra cakṣurnāsti sa paśyati || 88 ||
ghrāṇaṃ nāsti sugandhiṃ ca vāgvinā vacanaṃ tathā | jihvā nāsti rasaṃ gṛhya tvakvinā sparśanaṃ viduḥ || 89 ||
pāṇiṃ nāsti sa gṛhṇāti pādau nāsti sa gacchati | mano nāstīti saṃkalpya trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 90 ||

prakṛtirvinā mahāpuruṣo jagannāstīti ceṣṭitam | carācaramidaṃ sarvaṃ veṣṭate bhujate sadā || 91 ||

tanmadhye kurucātmānaṃ ātmamadhye ca taṃ kuru | sākṣāt śivamayaṃ kṛtvā na kiṃcidapi cintayet || 94 ||

ityevaṃ svapnabhūtiṃ ca maunamudrāṃ pradarśayet | taddhyānaṃ tajjapaṃ pūjā homakāryanna sādhanam || 96 ||
tīrthapātravitānaṃ ca varṇāśramavivarjitam | sannyāsī sarvakarmāṇi śivameva tu bhāvayet || 97 ||
digdeśasthānakālaṃ ca āsanaṃ caiva varjayet | tiṣṭhan gacchan svapan jāgran strīsaṅge bhojane'pi ca || 98 ||
vātaśītoṣṇakāleṣu bhayadāridryarāgake | garvakrodhamanobhāvo jñānājñāna iti bhrame || 99 ||
sarvadā sarvakāleṣu śivabhāvena niścalam | gurupādāt paraṃ nāsti ātmalābhāt parodayam || 100 ||
tasmād gurupadārthaṃ ca pūrṇabhāvaparodayam | sṛṣṭyādi ātmalābhāntaṃ daśabhedaṃ kramocyate || 101 ||
sadgurorupadeśena darśayejjīvamuktikaḥ | gururūpaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ gururūpaṃ paraṃ śivam || 102 ||
gururūpaṃ paraṃ jyotirgururūpaṃ parātparam | dhyānarūpo guro mūrti pūjābhāvo gurotpadam || 103 ||
mantramūlo gurorvākyaṃ mūrtimūlo guroḥ kṛpā | guruḥ pitā gururmātā sarvaṃ gurumayaṃ viduḥ || 104 ||
tasmād guruṃ śivaṃ paśyet sāyujyaṃ bhavati dhruvam | śaivarājendratatvajño śivabhāvena rājitam || 105 ||
navatattvajñadarśanaṃ mahātmānaṃ kramādviduḥ | śāstrārthaṃ guruvākyaṃ ca svānubhūtyā samaṃ viduḥ || 106 ||
manovākkāya ityetadaparādhaṃ kṣamasva me | śrīmūla śivapādārthadarśanaṃ tatprabhāvataḥ || 107 ||
